title: Submit for review
purpose: Send a completed excursion to a manager or administrator for review.

sections.title: Who can use it and when
paragraphs: Technicians, managers and administrators. When the action is not possible right now, the form opens with a Not available notice that gives the reason, its fields are disabled and there is no submit button; Cancel returns to the record. The checks are repeated on the server when you save, so a form that opens is not a guarantee. Only an open excursion can be submitted.

If someone else changed the record after you opened this form, the save is refused with a message that it changed since you opened it. Nothing is saved; reload, check the current values and enter the change again.

sections.title: Requirements
paragraphs: The excursion needs an end time, a cause, an action taken and an impact assessment. If any is missing the submission is refused and each missing item is named beside it; use Edit on the excursion first. The top shows the excursion, equipment, status and the limits in force.

items.label: Note
items.description: Optional, up to 4,000 characters, for the reviewer. Do not enter donor, patient or participant names or other text that could identify a person.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: Submit for review changes the status to Awaiting review, records you as the submitter and adds a timeline entry. While it is awaiting review it cannot be edited. A manager or administrator other than you reviews and closes it; a manager can also return it to you for more work.

sections.title: Manual holds
paragraphs: Holds placed from an excursion remain ordinary manual holds on the selected specimens. Submitting, closing, returning or reopening an excursion never releases them. A manager or administrator reviews and releases each from its specimen record with a reason.
